subject: SOC 2 + Pen Test: calendar stitching and slot proposal

Cc: eng@pentestco.com

Subject: SOC 2 + pen test: single session feasible?

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We are getting our compliance calendar in order and want to lock in a technical walkthrough that covers: SOC 2 scope review, pen test logistics (vendor handoff), and a brief DPA/collection discussion.

Two asks from our side:
- Can Redwood compress these topics into a single 90-minute session, or would you recommend splitting them into two 45-min sessions?
- Please share a couple of EMEA-friendly slot windows (we're GMT) and an availability grid.

I've attached our intake spreadsheet (FinTrust_Reqs.xlsx) — it has current auditor/vendor contacts and the preliminary control list. PentestCo is cc'd to confirm they can join the technical portion if we go with a combined session.

Best,
Marta Lopez
Security Lead, FinTrust
marta.lopez@fintrust.com

Attachment: FinTrust_Reqs.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com

Date: 2027-12-11T10:30:00+00:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 + pen test: single session feasible?

Hi Marta — thanks for the intake and the clear asks. We're happy to stitch this together either way; my quick take:

Option A — One consolidated 90-min session:
- Pros: fewer calendar hops for your team, better end-to-end context.
- Cons: risk of fatigue; might require a narrow attendee list per segment.

Option B — Two focused 45-min sessions (recommended for larger attendee lists):
- Session 1: SOC 2 controls + DPA clarifications (45m)
- Session 2: Pen test scope & logistics with PentestCo (45m)

Ben (cc) can run the SOC 2 + DPA block; Soojin will coordinate the pen test logistics with PentestCo.

Proposed slots (GMT):
- Thurs 2027-12-16: 09:30–10:15 (Session 1) and 10:30–11:15 (Session 2)
- Fri 2027-12-17: 14:00–14:45 and 15:00–15:45

I attached a one-tab availability grid (Availability_Grid_2027-12.xlsx) and our SOC2 overview deck for context. If those windows don't work, tell us a preferred day/time and we'll adjust.

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive — Security, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Availability_Grid_2027-12.xlsx (spreadsheet); SOC2_Overview_Deck.pdf (pdf)

Marta + Lauren — quick note from the technical side. If FinTrust will have both a broad controls team and an ops team on the call, I strongly prefer Option B (two 45-min sessions). That lets us keep the pen test discussion tightly scoped to the vendor and engineering folks; otherwise the session drifts and we lose time.

If you opt for two sessions, please confirm the core attendees per session (names/emails) so we can tailor the prep doc. Also: we'll upload a short pre-read (SOC2_Overview_Deck.pdf) and a pen-test readiness checklist once attendees are confirmed.
